verdict.rationale: vLLM's own docs list hardware plugins for Google TPUs and Intel Gaudi, along with other accelerators such as IBM Spyre and Huawei Ascend. That covers each element of the story: plugin-based inference on specialized accelerators like TPU and Gaudi. The evidence is a single overview line, supported only by a general 'any model on any hardware' claim. Missing for 10: plugin installation and usage documentation, details on feature parity or limitations for TPU and Gaudi backends, and independent or hands-on corroboration of running inference on these accelerators.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run inference on specialized accelerators like TPUs or Gaudi through plugin support

citations.quote: Additionally, diverse hardware plugins such as Google TPUs, Intel Gaudi, IBM Spyre, Huawei Ascend, Rebellions NPU, Apple Silicon, MetaX GPU, and more.
Run any model on any hardware.
